packet.userIntent: Two harvest runs corrupted the knowledge file yesterday.
packet.finalAssistantSummary: A project lock now serializes mutations.

evidence.excerpt: Concurrent runs interleaved writes and lost entries.
acquireProjectLock -> locks/<project>.lock held for the whole mutation section
Only one writer may mutate a project: every mutation path must hold the project lock for the entire read-modify-write.

claims.text: Knowledge mutations require holding the project lock across the whole read-modify-write section.

proposedEntry.title: One writer per project
proposedEntry.summary: Project mutations must hold the project lock for the entire read-modify-write.
proposedEntry.body: Interleaved writers lose entries. Every mutation path acquires the project lock before reading state and releases it only after the atomic write completes.

expect.notes: Operational constraint with a verified mechanism; durable and actionable.
